featured_reviews.name: Gordon Dcosta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amara’s first school/ play group.

We are absolutely delighted with our experience at The Kids Company Colaba. From the moment we walked through the doors, we knew this was the perfect environment for our child (Amara) to grow, learn, and thrive. The warm and welcoming atmosphere created by the dedicated staff makes every child feel at home.

The teachers & principal Ms Vibhuti /Ms Heena and Ms Kavita are not only highly skilled but also incredibly nurturing. They go above and beyond to ensure each child receives personalized attention and care. Our child has flourished under their guidance, developing both socially and academically in ways we could have only hoped for.

The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to balance play and learning, fostering creativity, curiosity, and a love for exploration. The wide range of activities, from arts and crafts to outdoor play, field trips, boat rides & Montessori learning method of education ensures that every day is filled with fun and discovery. We’ve also been impressed with the emphasis on social skills and emotional development, which are so crucial at this young age.

Moreover, the facilities are clean, safe, and equipped with age-appropriate resources that enhance the learning experience. We particularly appreciate the frequent communication from the school, keeping us informed and involved in our child’s progress.

We highly recommend “The Kids Company Colaba” to any parent seeking a nurturing, stimulating, and supportive environment for their child’s early education. This school has truly been a second home for our family, and we are grateful for the positive impact it has had on our child’s (Amara) development.

100% recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Amol Dhage
featured_reviews.review_text:
मी
अमोल ढगे वय 30 वर्षे
मी MMC चा सध्या माजी विद्यार्थी आहे, MMC बद्दल बोलावं तेवढं कमीच आहे अंगणवाडी पासून ते माजी विद्यार्थी च्या सर्वांगीण विकासाकरिता MMC नेहमीच तत्पर असते
मी आज पाचशे लोकांसमोर सुद्धा भाषण देऊ शकतो ते MMC ने दिलेल्या सॉफ्ट स्किल च्या कोर्स मुळे आणि माझ्या सारखे अनेक विद्यार्थी चांगल्या प्रकारे संभाषण करू शकतात ते फक्त MMC मुळे. प्रत्येक वर्षी हिरानंदनी मॅरेथॉन स्पर्धेत फ्री मध्ये सहभाग घेऊ शकतो फक्त MMC मुळे मला MMC कडून ड्रायव्हिंग लायसन्स मिळाले , पॅन कार्ड , आणि विशेष म्हणजे शाळेतले जुन्या मित्रांची भेट सुद्धा MMC कॅम्प च्या माध्यमातून करून देते
*या कोरोणाच्या महामारी मध्ये अनेकांचे जॉब गेलेत आणि त्यात लस घेण्यासाठी 7 से ते 8 से रूपये लागत आहेत पैशाच्या अडचणीमुळे कितेक लोकांची लस घेने बाकी आहे, सरकारी केंद्रावर जाऊन घेण्याची झाली तर सकाळी 4 वाजता पासून लाईन मध्ये उभ राहावं लागते परंतु MMC कडून आम्ही चांगल्या ठिकाणी फ्री मध्ये लस मिळाली* त्या बद्दल MMC आणि खास करून आम्हाला सतत योग्य मार्गदर्शन करणारे *मा. प्रदीप शिंदे सर* यांचे खूप खूप आभार MMC च असच प्रेम आम्हा सर्व माजी विद्यार्थ्यांवर राहावं हि अपेक्षा करतो
*मी सुरुवातीलाच लिहिले आहे MMC बद्दल बोलावे तेवढे कमीच आहे MMC एक ब्रँडेड कंपनी आहे आणि आम्ही त्या कंपनीचे ब्रँडेड प्रोडक्ट आहोत* thank you MMC
featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
I am Amol Dhage, 30 years old. I am a current alumni of MMC. There is not much to talk about MMC. From Anganwadi to alumni, MMC is always ready for the all-round development of its alumni. I can give a speech in front of five hundred people today because of the soft skills course given by MMC and many students like me can communicate well only because of MMC. Every year I can participate in the Hiranandani Marathon competition for free only because of MMC. I got my driving license, PAN card from MMC, and especially because of MMC, I also meet old friends from school through the camp. *Many people have lost their jobs in this corona epidemic and it costs 7 to 8 rupees to get the vaccine. Due to financial problems, many people have yet to get vaccinated. If you have to go to the government center to get it, you have to stand in line from 4 am, but from MMC we got the vaccine for free at a good place. * About that, MMC and especially *Mr. Thank you very much to Pradeep Shinde Sir* I hope that MMC's love will remain with all our alumni
*I have written in the beginning that there is very little to talk about MMC. MMC is a branded company and we are the branded product of that company* thank you MMC

featured_reviews.name: Ananya Bar
featured_reviews.review_text:
New Alpha Academy is a very good school for growing kids. We as a family were always worried for our son's first entry in school. But when we visited the school first time and met their director, Principal and all the Teachers, we were very much satisfied after talking to them. Further, while going through the school visit we were amazed and surprised the way they take care of our children in their learning. The atmosphere of the school is very good. Our son Johan Masih likes it very much. All the activities which were conducted offline were very good and the way kids were involved from all age groups whether it was sports or annual day or a outgoing trip, those were awesome. Online teaching at this age is very much encouraging and approaching to kids. They put all the skillful activities in online teaching and it is  successful and so interesting. We believe that not only our son but all the kids would have been benefitted by the hard work, dedication and love of the teachers.

Finally we would like to rate alpha academy teaching & learning 5/5 including the infrastructure facility. Hats off to all administration and all the loving teachers who have made our child's learning very good and made him feel at home. We are really grateful to God for giving such opportunity to our son's life to study in this school.

featured_reviews.name: Rachana Nalawade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined Purnank Swimming Coaching Center around six months ago. I was someone who always had a fear of water — on my very first day, I couldn’t even put my leg into the pool. I had a severe water phobia.

My coach, Mr. Prashant Shelar, played a huge role in helping me overcome that fear. He is extremely polite, humble, and patient. His teaching methods are excellent — he corrects strokes with precision and gives personal attention to every student in the pool. His constant encouragement and calm guidance made me feel confident and safe.

Thanks to his support, I learned swimming much faster than I ever imagined and completely overcame my fear of water. After completing my training at Purnank Swimming Coaching Center, I even started exploring water sports like surfing and water skiing. Today, I am proud to say that I am a Certified Level One Surfer and a Certified Water Skier.

I highly recommend Purnank Swimming Coaching Center to anyone who wants to learn swimming — whether you are a beginner, overcoming a fear, or looking to improve your skills. The coaches and staff are incredibly friendly, supportive, and professional, and the training packages are great value for money.

Thank you to the entire Purnank team for transforming my fear into confidence and helping me discover my love for the water!

featured_reviews.name: Yash Majalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:

They pay attention to every student, making sure everyone feels comfortable and confident in the water.
The teacher is very patient and supportive, especially with beginners, and always encourages us to improve without feeling pressured. Their friendly and motivating attitude creates a positive learning environment, which makes the classes enjoyable.
Overall, the teacher’s teaching is very good, and I have been able to improve my swimming skills significantly because of their guidance.

The programme also focuses on fitness and academics, which helps students grow in a balanced way. It also includes interaction with parents, which creates a strong support system for children.

The centre also organises well-structured vacation batches, which are perfect for students looking to utilise their holidays in a meaningful way. These batches are both fun and educational, allowing participants to learn while enjoying themselves. These not only keep students engaged but also help in building confidence, creativity, and teamwork.

Special thanks to Prashant Sir for this wonderful initiative. His dedication and care for children can clearly be seen in the way the centre works.

Overall, Purnank Activity Centre is a great place for young students to learn, grow, and improve themselves.

featured_reviews.name: PUNITHA PRABHA RAJENDRAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
I honestly don’t have enough words to express how grateful and happy we are with this preschool. My child, **Teril Joy**, has been here since Playgroup and is now in Nursery, and the journey has been absolutely wonderful.

From day one, the love, care, and personal attention given to each child is truly exceptional. The teachers are not just educators—they are nurturing, patient, and genuinely invested in every child’s growth. I’ve seen a remarkable improvement in Teril Joy’s confidence, communication, and overall development.

The environment is safe, warm, and very welcoming. The balance between academics and fun activities is perfect, making learning enjoyable for the kids. Every day, Teril Joy comes home with a smile and new things learned, which speaks volumes about the school.

What really stands out is the dedication of the entire team. They go above and beyond to ensure every child feels comfortable, valued, and encouraged.

Without a doubt, this is one of the best preschools in Bhandup and Kanjur East. I feel proud and lucky to have chosen this school for Teril Joy’s early education.

Highly recommended to all parents who want the best start for their little ones!
